A.text: Open the admin. You are already signed in.
A.extra: local: signed in as direction through wp-login (hosted link checked separately)

A.text: In the left-hand menu, choose « Congrès », then « Ajouter un congrès ».
Fill in the name, dates, city and discipline, then publish. To change one, open it from « Tous les congrès ».
Sign in as contributeur instead and your congress waits for review before it goes live.
Open the visitor site and go to the congress catalogue.
Type a word in the search box, or narrow the list by discipline, country or month.
Open a congress to see its details page: dates, city, venue and discipline.
On a congress details page, find « Demander un devis vol ».
Enter your contact details, departure city, travel dates and number of passengers.
Send it. You receive a reference number on screen.
In the same tab as task 3, click « Espace équipe » and sign in as equipe. Open « Demandes »: your enquiry is at the top.
Open it and change its status, for example from « Nouvelle » to « Qualifiée ». Each change is kept in its history.
Export the list as a spreadsheet file (CSV). « Journal des notifications » shows the message your team would have received.
Signed in as equipe, open « Accès GM&E »: the codes are hidden. Ask for access and give a reason.
Sign out, sign in as direction, and approve for 24 hours or refuse.
Sign in as equipe again: the code is shown, and the access record lists it.
A.why: hub says « the code is shown » after signing in; the reader must still click « Révéler le code »

B.text: Open the team console and sign in as contributeur.
Open the list of congresses and add a new one, or open an existing one to change it.
Send it for review. Sign in as direction to check it and publish it.
Open the visitor site and go to the congress catalogue.
Type a word in the search box, or narrow the list by discipline, country or month.
Open a congress to see its details page: dates, city, venue and discipline.
On a congress details page, open the flight enquiry form.
B.extra: form already open on the page (0 clicks)

B.text: Enter your contact details, departure city, travel dates and number of passengers.
Send it. You receive a reference number on screen.
Open the team console, sign in as equipe and open the enquiries.
Open your enquiry from task 3 and change its status. Each change is kept in its history.
Export the list as a spreadsheet file (CSV), and see the log of notifications your team would have received.
In the team console, sign in as equipe and open « Codes GM&E »: the codes are hidden. Ask for access and give a reason.
B.why: hub label « Codes GM&E »: label « Codes GM&E » is visible (p) but is not a link or a button

Choose the « Groupe » tab. Three fictional travellers have already answered.
Under « Lien de groupe », copy the link and open it in another tab. This is the traveller’s page.
Send an answer, then go back to the « Groupe » tab: it is in the list.
